remainingBoundaries: Local handoff bytes were not downloaded, checksum-verified, restored or semantically integrated; earlier proxy CONNECT 403 and the latest generic download failure are retained.
Paid Web pause Resume/Retry requires an unimplemented explicit financial continuation contract; ordinary operations intentionally refuse with no new financial or execution effects.
Linux native tests do not cover macOS-only code, macOS/ARM64 packaging, or the packaged Tauri desktop GUI/real IPC.
Browser acceptance uses synthetic IPC. No real model provider, external scan target or user database was used.
Legacy scanning/Agent include groups, Rust models aggregation, API compatibility facades and global CSS remain incremental migration debt.

Worker administration still adapts remote Scanning controls/DTOs, and Environment installation APIs still pass through Runtime. These are explicit transitional adapters, not a claim of complete infrastructure separation.

Legacy verified Native None full-finish reentry can renew exactly three timestamp metadata fields on its original lease. It is not claimed to be physical whole-database zero-write replay; modern supervision reentry retains that stronger invariant.

Two macOS-only exclusive-publication success cases and the Darwin-specific zombie-process-group contract are not compiled/executed on this Linux host. Their bodies remain for macOS verification; two actual Linux publication-refusal controls run instead of claiming Mac success.
The optional import-tools feature and its importer tests are outside this default-feature library/all-targets acceptance.
